'''Ryan Gamble''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Colorado Springs tournament]] on 8 July 2001 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2632">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-14-co-springs-co-7-8-01-its-an-ambushd2632/ co-springs-co-7-8-01-its-an-ambush], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 14 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-14-co-springs-co-7-8-01-its-an-ambushd2632/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
